text:
</sub>  Preserve the fail-fast guard in campaign commands

This block contains six commands that overwrite committed campaign records, but unlike the runbook blocks it calls “verbatim,” it omits `set -euo pipefail`. If any earlier arm exits nonzero, a copied execution continues into later arms and can leave a mixed or partial evidence set that appears to be a complete campaign; include the fail-fast guard before the first command.
